mapper.select: SELECT AI_INPT_ANNO_SRNO AS annoSrno, INPT_MST_SRNO AS inptMstSrno, INPT_TASK_ID AS inptTaskId, INPT_BL_GRP_NO AS inptBlGrpNo, IMEX_HIS_CD AS imexHisCd, AI_INPT_ANNO_TYP_CD AS annoTypCd, AI_INPT_ANNO_ID AS annoId, AI_INPT_COLOR_VAL AS colorVal, AI_INPT_LINE_WD AS lineWd, AI_INPT_POINTS_TXT AS pointsTxt, AI_INPT_PIN_X AS pinX, AI_INPT_PIN_Y AS pinY, AI_INPT_OPINION_TXT AS opinionTxt, AI_INPT_IMG_WD AS imgWd, AI_INPT_IMG_HT AS imgHt FROM CSPD134TA WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND AI_INPT_USG_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY AI_INPT_ANNO_SRNO

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CSPD134TA ( AI_INPT_ANNO_SRNO, INPT_MST_SRNO, INPT_TASK_ID, INPT_BL_GRP_NO, IMEX_HIS_CD, AI_INPT_ANNO_TYP_CD, AI_INPT_ANNO_ID, AI_INPT_COLOR_VAL, AI_INPT_LINE_WD, AI_INPT_POINTS_TXT, AI_INPT_PIN_X, AI_INPT_PIN_Y, AI_INPT_OPINION_TXT, AI_INPT_IMG_WD, AI_INPT_IMG_HT, AI_INPT_USG_YN, TRN_LOG_SRNO, LST_DB_CHG_ID, LST_DB_CHG_DTM ) VALUES ( #{annoSrno}, #{inptMstSrno}, #{inptTaskId}, #{inptBlGrpNo}, #{imexHisCd}, #{annoTypCd}, #{annoId}, #{colorVal}, #{lineWd}, #{pointsTxt}, #{pinX}, #{pinY}, #{opinionTxt}, #{imgWd}, #{imgHt}, 'Y', #{trnLogSrno}, #{lstDbChgId}, )
